I really like this product. I am currently using a DermaRoller for a scar on my nose, which I got from MOHS surgery for skin cancer. The DermaRoller suggests that you apply a good quality lotion to your skin, with minerals and such, before and after rolling. So far, I am loving this product. It helps my skin heal quicker, reduces the inflamation and redness associated with the rolling process. I don't have any negative things to say about this product; I really like it!
